detail.longDescription: Google Labs is testing Tabletop, a shared planning space that turns prompts and templates into interactive workspaces for itineraries, polls, expense splitting and brackets. Collaborators can add links, files and ideas in real time. It’s still an experiment, with rolling access through a U.S. waitlist for people 18+. https:// blog.google/innovation-and-ai/ models-and-research/google-labs/tabletop/ # AI # Productivity
